description: Build the user's iOS app for the simulator from an Xcode project/workspace (auto-detects the container and scheme under projectDir, default cwd), install it on the booted simulator, and return the bundle id. Use before tapp_explore / tapp_open_app when the app isn't installed yet — no bundle id needed up front.

install.description: Install on the booted simulator after building

projectDir.description: Repo/dir to search for the .xcworkspace/.xcodeproj (default: cwd)

name: tapp_build
title: Build the iOS app
